item.title: useR! 2022: My 'Futureverse: Profile Parallel Code' Slides
item.description: Figure 1: A time chart of logged events for two futures resolved by two parallel workers. This is a screenshot of Slide #18 in my talk. Below are the slides for my Futureverse: Profile Parallel Code talk that I presented at the useR! 2022 conference online and hosted by the Department of Biostatistics at Vanderbilt University Medical Center. Title: Futureverse: Profile Parallel Code Speaker: Henrik Bengtsson Session: #21: Parallel Computing, chaired by Ilias Moutsopoulos
